title: Subsurface Workbench deck configuration, schema 1
description: config.json beside the deck: where its wells come from and which identity provider signs the user in. Public values only; a key that could hold a credential is refused.

version.description: The schema this file is written for. Missing means 1. A deck refuses a config written for a newer schema.

sources.description: Where the wells come from, in the order they are read. The first source to serve a well id keeps it.

oneOf.description: The bundled public and synthetic wells (Utah FORGE, FORCE 2020, Equator, Kestrel A-7). Leave it out of a client deployment.
Wells the user entered, imported or designed on the deck, kept in their browser.

url.description: A subsurface-wells file, or a subsurface-wells-index page, in the data contract's JSON.
The OSDU platform's base URL, or a path beside the deck that proxies to it.

dataPartition.description: Sent as the data-partition-id header on every request.

kinds.description: The record kinds asked for; patterns such as *:*:master-data--Well:1.*.* are allowed.

query.description: An extra Search query that every well must match, e.g. to one basin.

auth.description: Identity providers by profile name; a source names the profile it signs in with. A public client: there is never a secret.

issuer.description: The OpenID issuer; its discovery document is at <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration.

scopes.description: openid, profile, offline_access, and the backend's resource scope (e.g. an Entra application id URI with /.default).

extraParams.description: Extra authorization-request parameters some providers need (audience, resource).

metadata.description: Endpoints given outright when discovery does not cover them.

mode.description: reference: links carry ids and view state only (a client's default). carry: the sender's own wells travel in the link (the public demo). off: no sharing.

connectSrc.description: Extra https origins the browser may connect to, beyond the sources and providers above. No wildcards.

endpoint.description: The tenant's own OpenTelemetry collector. Off when absent; nothing is ever sent anywhere else.

definitions.description: The tenant's own coordinate reference systems (a local grid, an engineering CRS), by code, as proj4 strings. EPSG codes come with the SDK.

sourceUrl.description: An https URL, or a path beside the deck (no scheme).

authRef.description: The name of a profile under auth.
